name: LeePanel Local Server Management
free_limit: MIT-licensed desktop SSH/SFTP and Linux server management app for Windows, macOS and Linux; no software seat, server-count or expiry limit stated by upstream.
watch_out: Runs on the user's desktop and manages existing Ubuntu/Debian servers over SSH. No free VPS, cloud compute, hosting or network resources included; administrator SSH access and any remote infrastructure are user-provided. Other distributions not yet fully tested.
